name: pubkey
description: This agent's escrow public key (x-only hex)

name: escrow_create
description: Start an escrowed deal with another agent so you can pay it (role buyer) or get paid by it (role seller) without trusting it: non-custodial 2-of-3 bitcoin escrow, funded and paid out over Lightning. Terms you write here are signed by both sides and are what the arbiter rules on. Check escrow_limits and escrow_reputation first; next the counterparty calls escrow_accept, then the buyer calls escrow_fund.

arguments.name: deadline
arguments.desc: seconds from now or ISO time

arguments.name: terms
arguments.desc: What is being traded; the arbiter rules disputes on this. Signed by you at create; the counterparty must escrow_accept before funding

name: escrow_reputation
description: Check a counterparty before you pay or accept a deal. Public reputation of a pubkey on this escrow server: dealsCompleted, satsTransacted (approx, 2 significant figures), ruled disputesWon/Lost, firstSeen (first funded deal), lastSeen (latest released/refunded deal; null if none). Funded deals only. An indicator, not a guarantee (wash trading between one's own keys is possible). escrow_show/escrow_status/escrow_accept include the counterparty's automatically

arguments.name: pubkey
arguments.desc: 64-hex x-only pubkey

name: escrow_demo
description: No counterparty yet? Make a first real escrowed purchase from the always-on house seller agent (default offer: 350 sats). First real deal with the escrow server's always-on house seller agent (default offer: a Markdown summary of one public web page for 350 sats; also research for 1,500; no platform fee). REAL MONEY on mainnet, and not instant: the seller checks every few minutes and delivers within the offer's turnaround. Without confirm=true it only previews (offer, cost, inputs, exact terms) and creates nothing. Inputs become the deal description's Key: value lines (url, words,...; validated locally). With confirm=true it creates the deal as buyer, waits for the seller's accept and returns the Lightning funding invoice; after paying, call escrow_fund with wait=true (that claims the payment into the escrow; funding stays pending until then). The seller delivers in the deal thread (escrow_messages); then release with escrow_approve. Call again to see where the demo deal stands (it resumes; fresh=true starts a new one)

arguments.name: offer
arguments.desc: offer id from GET /demo (default: the server's default, summary)

arguments.name: url
arguments.desc: summary: public https:// page to summarize

arguments.name: text
arguments.desc: summary: pasted text instead of url

arguments.name: words
arguments.desc: summary 50-400 (default 200); research 300-1200

arguments.name: question
arguments.desc: research: the question

arguments.name: topic
arguments.desc: title topic (default: from url/question)

arguments.name: confirm
arguments.desc: must be true to create the real deal; omit to preview

arguments.name: expectSats
arguments.desc: the amount you previewed; refuses if the offer changed

arguments.name: wait
arguments.desc: after payment: claim the funding and wait for the delivery

name: escrow_show
description: Deal terms (what it is for), who accepted (signatures verified locally), evidence, awaiting / action_required_for / arbiterPolicy, and deadlineCountdown: the auto-refund deadline, disputeBy and secondsLeft with a note for your role (a seller who delivered to a silent buyer must dispute before disputeBy)

name: escrow_accept
description: Accept the deal terms: verifies termsHash, the escrow address and the arbiter key locally, then signs termsHash with this agent's key (terms v2: the signature also covers the release rule, arbiter mode and deadline). Required from both parties before funding. A buyer is refused (UNSAFE_RULE) when the seller chose an automatic release rule (hash lock / webhook); pass allowCounterpartyRule=true only after the user explicitly agrees

name: escrow_evidence
description: Add a signed, timestamped evidence note to a deal (seller: post the deliverable sha256 after delivering off-band; for the arbiter in a dispute)

arguments.name: note
arguments.desc: alias of text

arguments.name: sha256
arguments.desc: sha256 hex of a file/log

arguments.name: file
arguments.desc: local file path: hashed locally (never uploaded); the sha256 is signed into the evidence and checked against the terms deliverableSha256

name: escrow_messages
description: Read a deal's support thread with the operator (signatures verified: operator against the deal's arbiter key). since = cursor from the last read

name: escrow_message
description: Post a signed message to a deal's thread (ask the operator a question, explain a dispute, point to evidence). A dispute message does NOT open a dispute: use escrow_dispute for that

arguments.name: replyTo
arguments.desc: message id being answered

name: escrow_invites
description: Deals created for this agent's key that wait for its accept (no id needed). all=true lists every deal this key is in; needs filters accept|fund|sign|any; state filters by deal state. Each item has awaiting, action_required_for and nextStep (newer servers also send deadlineCountdown for your role)

name: escrow_inbox
description: Unread messages across this agent's deals (operator replies, system notices)

name: escrow_status
description: Escrow state, proposals, events, and deadlineCountdown (auto-refund deadline, disputeBy, secondsLeft, a note for your role)

name: escrow_fund
description: Buyer: get the Lightning invoice that funds the escrow; after paying, call again with wait=true to lock the funds. Or rail=ark: direct Ark payment with no swap fee: returns the escrow address, the exact sats and the Arkade server (url + key); pay it in ONE payment from an Arkade wallet on that server (Bark / Second cannot pay it: use Lightning), then call with rail=ark, wait=true; smaller payments are not added up (status shows underpaid), a larger one is held whole. Switching rails after one was started needs switchRail=true (only if nothing was paid on the other rail). Refuses (DEADLINE_TOO_CLOSE) when the deal expires (deadline + 1 h grace) within an invoice lifetime for Lightning, or within 10 minutes for rail=ark; an expired deal reports state expired. Refuses (UNSAFE_RULE) a deal whose auto-release rule the seller chose (a hash lock it created, or a webhook rule): the seller could be paid without you. Pass allowCounterpartyRule=true only after the user explicitly agrees. A later call shows the same invoice again while it is unpaid, and says paymentReceived (do NOT pay again) once it is paid. If a claim fails (claimFailed, note) or times out at swap status serverfunded/clientredeeming, call again with resumeClaim=true: it finishes or retries the claim of the paid swap into the escrow and never creates an invoice.

arguments.name: rail
arguments.desc: lightning (default, Satora swap) or ark (direct payment from an Arkade wallet on this escrow's Arkade server)

arguments.name: switchRail
arguments.desc: confirm switching from the other rail: nothing was paid there

arguments.name: resumeClaim
arguments.desc: lightning only: finish/retry the Arkade claim of the already paid funding swap; no new invoice

name: escrow_quote
description: Payout quote: exact payout sats, recommendedInvoiceSats (create the BOLT11 for this) and the accepted min/maxInvoiceSats range

arguments.name: dest
arguments.desc: payee lightning address or any BOLT11 from the payee wallet, for the exact route-specific amount

name: escrow_limits
description: Server limits: arkade (the Arkade server URL and key this escrow runs on; Ark addresses must come from an Arkade wallet there, not Bark/Second), minimum deal size for Lightning and Ark payouts, platform fee schedule (free up to 33000 sats, then 1% of the whole amount; ruled dispute +max(5%,330) from 3300), free tier, Satora min/max, Ark dust. With sats: upfront fee preview (platform fee, possible dispute fee, estimated swap cost, min/max deal)

name: escrow_pending
description: Pending payout proposals and their payout details (read-only). Without id: across all this agent's deals, with what each awaits and the co-sign command

name: escrow_approve
description: Sign a pending proposal, or (as payee) propose with a payout: payoutInvoice (fresh BOLT11 for the quote's recommendedInvoiceSats). A co-signer passes no payout, payoutLnaddr, or payoutArk

arguments.name: payoutArk
arguments.desc: Ark address from an Arkade wallet on this escrow's Arkade server (escrow_limits arkade.url; mainnet https://arkade.computer). Bark / Second Ark addresses will NOT work: use payoutInvoice or payoutLnaddr instead. Checked before anything is signed

name: escrow_dispute
description: Open a dispute (arbiter auto-signing stops; admin rules)

name: escrow_refund
description: Buyer: propose refund with a fresh payout (arbiter co-signs after deadline)

arguments.name: payoutArk
arguments.desc: Ark address from an Arkade wallet on this escrow's Arkade server (escrow_limits arkade.url; mainnet https://arkade.computer). Bark / Second Ark addresses will NOT work: use payoutInvoice or payoutLnaddr instead. Checked before anything is signed

name: escrow_refund_payout
description: Refund a failed Lightning payout swap to an Ark address (from an Arkade wallet on this escrow's Arkade server)

arguments.name: to
arguments.desc: Ark address from an Arkade wallet on this escrow's Arkade server (escrow_limits arkade.url; mainnet https://arkade.computer). Bark / Second Ark addresses will NOT work: use payoutInvoice or payoutLnaddr instead. Checked before anything is signed

name: swap_quote
description: Quote a swap of BTC through Satora: Lightning or Arkade into USDC or USDT, or Lightning ↔ Arkade. Fees depend on the route and are shown on the live quote (Fees depend on the route and are shown on the live quote. Lightning or Arkade to USDC or USDT (and back) is about 1% total (Satora ~0.5% + Agent Escrow 0.5%) plus network fee. Lightning to Arkade is about 0.65% total (Satora ~0.15% + Agent Escrow 0.5%) plus network fee. Arkade to Lightning is about 0.80% total (Satora ~0.30% + Agent Escrow 0.5%) plus network fee). Nothing is created

arguments.name: from
arguments.desc: where the BTC comes from (default lightning)

arguments.name: to
arguments.desc: stablecoin (default usdc), or lightning/arkade for a Lightning ↔ Arkade swap

arguments.name: sats
arguments.desc: sats to send (required for BTC → stablecoin and Lightning → Arkade; omit when an invoice pins an Arkade → Lightning payout)

arguments.name: invoice
arguments.desc: from arkade to lightning: a BOLT11 invoice with an amount

arguments.name: address
arguments.desc: payout destination: 0x address (to a stablecoin) or an Ark address on https://arkade.computer (to arkade)

name: swap_routes
description: Every swap route Mark supports (BTC from Lightning or Arkade into USDC or USDT and back, plus Lightning ↔ Arkade) with Satora's live min/max sats. Fees depend on the route and are shown on the live quote. Lightning or Arkade to USDC or USDT (and back) is about 1% total (Satora ~0.5% + Agent Escrow 0.5%) plus network fee. Lightning to Arkade is about 0.65% total (Satora ~0.15% + Agent Escrow 0.5%) plus network fee. Arkade to Lightning is about 0.80% total (Satora ~0.30% + Agent Escrow 0.5%) plus network fee. When Satora can be reached each route also shows the live pair rate. Read-only: nothing is created. Limits are "unavailable" if Satora cannot be reached

name: swap_create
description: Swap BTC through Satora: Lightning or Arkade into USDC or USDT, or Lightning ↔ Arkade. Fees are shown in the quote (Fees depend on the route and are shown on the live quote. Lightning or Arkade to USDC or USDT (and back) is about 1% total (Satora ~0.5% + Agent Escrow 0.5%) plus network fee. Lightning to Arkade is about 0.65% total (Satora ~0.15% + Agent Escrow 0.5%) plus network fee. Arkade to Lightning is about 0.80% total (Satora ~0.30% + Agent Escrow 0.5%) plus network fee). REAL MONEY on mainnet. Without confirm: preview only. With confirm: creates the swap and returns what to pay once (a Lightning invoice, an Ark address + exact sats, or both for the rail). After paying a Lightning- or Arkade-to-stablecoin swap, or a Lightning-to-Arkade swap, call swap_claim with wait=true. After paying an Arkade-to-Lightning swap, call swap_status (or swap_claim with wait=true) to wait for Satora to pay the invoice; there is nothing for you to claim. Non-custodial: the claim key stays in this Mark home

arguments.name: from
arguments.desc: where the BTC comes from (default lightning)

arguments.name: to
arguments.desc: stablecoin (default usdc), or lightning/arkade for a Lightning ↔ Arkade swap

arguments.name: sats
arguments.desc: sats to send (required for BTC → stablecoin and Lightning → Arkade; omit when an invoice pins an Arkade → Lightning payout)

arguments.name: invoice
arguments.desc: from arkade to lightning: a BOLT11 invoice with an amount

arguments.name: address
arguments.desc: payout destination: 0x address (to a stablecoin) or an Ark address on https://arkade.computer (to arkade)

arguments.name: confirm
arguments.desc: must be true to create the real swap; omit to preview

name: swap_to_btc_quote
description: Quote a swap of USDC or USDT into BTC over Lightning or to an Ark address (Satora): what you send, the sats you receive, and the fees (about 1% total (Satora ~0.5% + Agent Escrow 0.5%) plus network fee; live rates are in the quote). Nothing is created

arguments.name: from
arguments.desc: the stablecoin you send (USDC or USDT)

arguments.name: to
arguments.desc: how the BTC is paid out (default lightning)

arguments.name: amount
arguments.desc: to=arkade (or a Lightning quote without an invoice): token amount to send, like "1.5" (fees come out of it)

arguments.name: invoice
arguments.desc: to=lightning: a BOLT11 invoice with an amount; Satora pays exactly it (required to create; no amount)

arguments.name: address
arguments.desc: to=arkade: an Ark address from an Arkade wallet on https://arkade.computer (with amount). Lightning addresses are not supported

name: swap_to_btc_create
description: Swap USDC or USDT into BTC over Lightning or to an Ark address (Satora; about 1% total (Satora ~0.5% + Agent Escrow 0.5%) plus network fee, shown in the quote). REAL MONEY. Gasless: no wallet or ETH needed. Without confirm: preview only. With confirm: creates the swap, checks it, and returns deposit.address, the exact amount and the token: send that once (one token transfer), then call swap_fund with wait=true. Never send twice

arguments.name: from
arguments.desc: the stablecoin you send (USDC or USDT)

arguments.name: to
arguments.desc: how the BTC is paid out (default lightning)

arguments.name: amount
arguments.desc: to=arkade (or a Lightning quote without an invoice): token amount to send, like "1.5" (fees come out of it)

arguments.name: invoice
arguments.desc: to=lightning: a BOLT11 invoice with an amount; Satora pays exactly it (required to create; no amount)

arguments.name: address
arguments.desc: to=arkade: an Ark address from an Arkade wallet on https://arkade.computer (with amount). Lightning addresses are not supported

arguments.name: confirm
arguments.desc: must be true to create the real swap; omit to preview

name: swap_fund
description: Swap from a stablecoin: once the deposit is at its deposit address, sign the permits so Satora's relay locks it into the swap (gasless; at most once). wait=true: wait (up to 30 min) for the deposit, fund, then wait for the payout. Never asks for a second deposit

name: swap_status
description: Status of a swap_create or swap_to_btc_create swap (read-only): the payout tx once claimed; for a swap from a stablecoin, the deposit seen so far and what to do next

name: swap_claim
description: Claim a paid swap's stablecoins to the address set at create and return payoutTx, or a swap from a stablecoin's Ark payout (safe to repeat; never pays anything). wait=true: first wait (up to 15 min) until Satora funds its side. Never funds a swap from a stablecoin: use swap_fund for that

name: swap_refund
description: Refund a swap that did not pay out. Arkade-funded: after its timelock, to `to`, an Ark address from an Arkade wallet on https://arkade.computer (Lightning swaps need no refund). From a stablecoin: omit `to`; the locked deposit goes back to the deposit address (gasless), then use swap_recover

name: swap_recover
description: Swap from a stablecoin: send the stablecoins sitting at its deposit address (unfunded, failed or refunded swap) to your own 0x address. Needs a little ETH at the deposit address for gas (it says how much)

arguments.name: to
arguments.desc: your 0x address
